23144-the-war-trail-the-hunt-of-the-wild.title: The War Trail The Hunt Of The Wild Horse
23144-the-war-trail-the-hunt-of-the-wild.creator: Unknown
23144-the-war-trail-the-hunt-of-the-wild.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Bright land of Anahuac! my spirit mounts upon the aerial wings of Fancy, and once more I stand upon thy shores! Over thy broad savannahs I spur my noble steed, whose joyous neigh tells that he too is inspired by the scene. I rest under the shade of the _corozo_ palm, and quaff the wine of the _acrocomia_. I climb thy mountains of amygdaloid and porphyry-- thy crags of quartz, that yield the white silver and the yellow gold.

arxiv-2208-12264.title: Identifying and Overcoming Transformation Bias in Forecasting Models
arxiv-2208-12264.creator: Sushant More morsusha@amazon.com
arxiv-2208-12264.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sushant More morsusha@amazon.com. Log and square root transformations of target variable are routinely used in forecasting models to predict future sales. These transformations often lead to better performing models. However, they also introduce a systematic negative bias (under-forecasting). In this paper, we demonstrate the existence of this bias, dive deep into its root cause and introduce two methods to correct for the bias.

arxiv-2209-05148.title: Personalized Federated Learning with Communication Compression
arxiv-2209-05148.creator: El Houcine Bergou, Konstantin Burlachenko, Aritra Dutta, Peter Richtárik
arxiv-2209-05148.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by El Houcine Bergou, Konstantin Burlachenko, Aritra Dutta, Peter Richtárik. In contrast to training traditional machine learning (ML) models in data centers, federated learning (FL) trains ML models over local datasets contained on resource-constrained heterogeneous edge devices. Existing FL algorithms aim to learn a single global model for all participating devices, which may not be helpful to all devices participating in the training due to the heterogeneity of the data across the devices.

pmc-11299457.title: Mortality in Innu communities in Labrador, 1993-2018: a cross-sectional study of causes and location of death
pmc-11299457.creator: Russell Dawe, Jack Penashue, John C Knight, Andrea Pike, Mary Pia Benuen, Anastasia Qupee, Nathaniel J Pollock
pmc-11299457.description: In Canada, most people prefer to die at home. However, the proportion of deaths that occur in hospital has increased over time. This study examined mortality rates and proportionate mortality in Innu communities in Labrador, and compared patterns to other communities in Labrador and Newfoundland. We conducted a cross-sectional ecological study with mortality data from the vital statistics system.

pmc-11546966.creator: Andrew McClennan, Lisa Hoffman
pmc-11546966.description: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is a degenerative neuromuscular disease caused by a lack of functional dystrophin. pmc-12636394.title: Cerenkov luminescence microscopy: A novel approach for high-resolution radiotracer imaging
pmc-12636394.creator: Lisa Alborghetti, Federica Vurro, Sara Belloli, Paolo Rainone, Silvia Valtorta, Macrina Milani Capialbi, Maria Assunta Lacavalla, Stefano Pizzardi, Rosa Maria Moresco, Federico Boschi, Antonello Enrico Spinelli
pmc-12636394.description: SummaryThis study introduces a novel imaging system utilizing Cerenkov luminescence microscopy (CLM) to visualize the activity of radioactive tracers in 3D tumor spheroids. The system integrates an EMCCD camera, a microscope objective, and a precise sample positioning setup, enabling the high-resolution detection of Cerenkov light emission from radiotracers in a light-tight environment.

pmc-13287522.title: Co-creation and interprofessional collaborative practice for the local management of osteoporosis: a qualitative study in primary healthcare
pmc-13287522.creator: Jenny Nilsson, Helena Salminen, Eva Toth-Pal, Hans Ranch Lundin
pmc-13287522.description: BackgroundInterprofessional collaborative practice (ICP) benefits patients with complex conditions such as osteoporosis that require care from multiple professions. ICP is not consistently applied in osteoporosis management in primary healthcare today.ObjectivesTo explore how an ICP intervention promoting co-creation of osteoporosis management was conducted and how it was experienced by nurses and physicians in primary healthcare.

pmc-13361378.title: Apathy and Reduced Voluntary Activity in Older Adults with Parkinson’s Disease: Mechanisms, Clinical Assessment, and Rehabilitation Implications
pmc-13361378.creator: Jianda Kong, Zizheng Yang, Yang Liu, Wei Chen
pmc-13361378.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Apathy in Parkinson’s disease is characterized by reduced self-initiated, goal-directed behaviour and may overlap clinically with bradykinesia, akinesia, freezing of gait, fatigue, depression, and executive dysfunction. This narrative Review argues that reduced voluntary activity in Parkinson’s disease reflects two interacting but partially dissociable domains: motor-execution deficits mediated mainly by nigrostriatal cortico-basal ganglia circuits, and motivational-initiation deficits mediated by mesolimbic, prefrontal-striatal, limbic, and non-dopaminergic modulatory systems.

pmc-13463957.title: Evaluating the effectiveness and utilization of the primary emergency care training in Nepal: a longitudinal mixed methods study
pmc-13463957.creator: Rabindra Bhandari, Arpana B C Kalaunee, Archana Amatya, Yadu Chandra Ghimire, Madhab Prasad Lamsal, Deepa Chitrakar, Babu Ram Bhusal, Anjila Thapa, Abigail Knoble, Pravin Paudel, Ruma Rajbhandari
pmc-13463957.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEmergency care is essential for the management of the growing burden of disease and traffic injuries in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). In Nepal, nearly one in ten deaths in 2017 were attributed to injury. The Primary Emergency Care (PEC) training package of 6 days duration was developed to equip the various health care cadres with knowledge and skills to deliver emergency response.
